title: Singleton Fourier coefficient and influence
statement: For any Boolean function $f$ on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ and any coordinate $i$, the absolute value of its Fourier coefficient at $\\{i\\}$ is at most its influence at $i$.
